Luck burns permanently for a +1 bonus - it rarely returns once spent.

Judges: Remind them that burning Luck permanently for a +1 is a one-way street - Thieves get it back, the rest don't.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

Backstab hits harder than expected - an extra weapon die plus half thief level in additional dice.

GMs: Ensure the target is unaware before allowing Backstab; otherwise, it's just a wasted action and a lesson learned.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Vicious Greatsword deals more damage than expected - an extra 2d6 on a hit.

DMs: Use the Vicious Greatsword's 2d6 bonus damage to decisively end stalemates or eliminate priority targets.

One ruling a day, no fluff. Follow @bizzalgames70.

Velociraptor's surprise attack hits harder than expected - +1d4 damage with surprise.

GMs: Let the Velociraptor's double near movement punish sloppy positioning with its +1d4 surprise damage.

Damage Rolls often surprise players with their variability - modifiers apply after rolling the dice.

DMs: Remind players to roll damage dice first, then add modifiers, as outlined in section 16 of the rules.

One ruling a day, no fluff. Follow @bizzalgames70.

Clerics face a unique challenge with spellcasting - every failed spell check adds 1 point of deity.

Judges: Remind clerics that every failed spell check adds to deity disapproval; prioritize spells with higher success odds to avoid divine backlash.

Daily tabletop RPG rulings. Follow @bizzalgames70 for one a day.

Pit Fighter's early power spike hinges on a narrow survival window - Last Stand triggers on a natural 18-20.

GMs: Design encounters that force Pit Fighters to rely on Last Stand's 18-20 trigger for survival.

Ran it differently at your table? Drop it in the comments. @bizzalgames70

Inflict Wounds surprises with its touch range - 0 feet means you need to plan your approach carefully.

DMs: Target enemies with low Constitution saves for Inflict Wounds' 2d10 necrotic damage; avoid wasting it on high-Constitution creatures.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Run Boneshard Swarm of Bones with a hard clock and consequences each round; indecision should hurt more than damage.

Judges: Remind them that blindsight makes stealth pointless; they must stay beyond 60' or risk being shredded by shards.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

Animate Dead shifts the tactical landscape more than expected - duration extends to 1 day.

GMs: Use Animate Dead's 1-day duration to block paths or divert foes, not just for close-range combat.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Horned Devil punishes poor positioning - its Infernal Tail and Hurl Flame can devastate clustered targets.

DMs: Enforce the Horned Devil's 150-foot Hurl Flame range to punish players who cluster and fail to spread out.

Ran it differently at your table? Drop it in the comments. @bizzalgames70

Hunter (Bane Weapon) sees through invisibility better than most players expect - a +10 Will save against.

Judges: Remind players that Hunter's +10 Will save is for when the enemy's actually concealed, not just because it's Tuesday.
